app_name: ADHD Habit Tracker, To Do List
title: Tried many Habit trackers...
body: Before I decide which app I want to use and integrate into my life, I first download like 5-10 alike apps and test them all for a specific timeframe. So I downloaded several habit/life tracker apps (also the expensive one) and tested them all. This has to be by far the best and simple habit tracker app I tested, so I immediately bought the lifetime sub. I am using it everyday, every night. Definitely worth it👍🏼
author: GeizhalsLover
